steps: Cook grenade at white laundry ticket
Collect displaced ticket
Collect one fuse in each of Canal, Footlight, Waterfront
Install all three at Rift master switch
Pay 2000 at emergency response panel
sideQuests.reward: temporary allied Civil Protector; can revive players

steps: Collect one shield part in each district from randomized spawn set
Build at one of three workbenches
Score twelve shield-boost attacks killing at least ten zombies each
First Margwa heart
Xenomatter from Parasites/Insanity Elementals after late early-game threshold
Tentacle from mature purple Harvest Pod
Build at workbench
sideQuests.reward: Apothicon Servant; add copies to box pool after build

steps: Throw Widow's Wine grenade into each of four lion mouths in Canal room
Collect grey orb
Place at candy/ice-cream shop plate
Wait full rounds
Kill six Margwas globally; co-op kills count toward the shared unlock
After the sixth kill, six hidden Margwa-heart targets become active around Tram sightlines
Shoot every heart while physically riding the moving Tram
Complete all six within at most two Tram rides; starting a third ride before completion resets all six targets
Collect the unlocked sparkling/invisible Margwa Mask pickup from its randomized ritual-room spawn
Each active player may equip the unlocked mask
sideQuests.reward: wearable Margwa Mask that protects against the Margwa slam path

steps: Activate three wooden radios/clocks: Anvil Gym, Footlight station, Ruby Rabbit
sideQuests.reward: music event hook; copyrighted song not bundled

steps: Collect microphone stand in Nero's room
Collect cable in Canals
Collect microphone in Rift tunnel
Assemble on Black Lace stage
sideQuests.reward: music event hook; copyrighted song not bundled

steps: At game start shoot Shadowman repeatedly
sideQuests.reward: conditional jump to round 5/10/15 plus points

steps: Get 100 Lil' Arnie kills
Throw Arnies at top hat, cane, bow tie props
Throw fourth Arnie on Burlesque ritual table
sideQuests.reward: upgraded Lil' Arnies and dance event

steps: Buy Trip Mines outside/left side of Anvil Boxing Gym
Choose a visual path implicitly by damaging the opposing pastry carts; helping Holly means damage Devil-O-Donuts carts, helping Devil means damage Holly's Cream Cakes carts
Holly's carts: Junction near Stamin-Up; Canals by Peep Show around corner from Civil Protector panel; Footlight in front of rotating perk machine on upper level
Devil-O-Donuts carts: Junction near GobbleGum machine; Canals near GobbleGum machine; Footlight up stairs/left from perk area; Waterfront near Championship Belt drop
Damaging a cart belonging to the side you are helping locks the upgrade out for the rest of the match
Complete every opposing cart for the chosen route
sideQuests.reward: Upgraded pastry Trip Mines: same mechanics for both routes, larger/stronger blast plus visual doughnuts/cakes

steps: Open Anvil Boxing Gym in Beast Mode
Interact with paired boxing-gym photographs while Beast
Support twelve telephone/portal messages with progression gates
From Waterfront/Boxing Gym harbor sightline, aim a scoped sniper at the glowing window on the large ship
sideQuests.copyrightRule: recreate visual effect with project-owned/cleared art; do not bundle ripped Treyarch imagery/audio
